exposure: time from oocyte retrieval to frozen embryo transfer (natural cycle FET in first vs. second menstrual cycle)
cohort: The study included 576 consecutive freeze-all cycles from January 2011 to December 2018, followed by natural cycle FET of a single blastocyst.
finding: Performing a natural cycle FET of a single blastocyst in the second compared with the first menstrual cycle after ovarian stimulation did not statistically significantly impact the odds of live birth or neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: babies whose birth weight was assessed for Small for Gestational Age (SGA) status
gest_age: babies with gestational age assessed for preterm delivery (24-37 weeks) and Small for Gestational Age (SGA) status
